usage: FFL.pyc share [-h] [--version] [--cli] [--log-level LEVEL_OR_FILE]
                     [--proxy PROXY] [--hook WEBHOOK_URL] [--enable-reporting]
                     [--name FILENAME] [--exclude PATTERNS] [--json JSON_FILE]
                     [--upload [{unavailable}]] [--resume]
                     [--pause PERCENTAGE] [--yes] [--legacy-link URL]
                     [--max-downloads MAXDOWNLOADS] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                     [--port PORT] [--auth-user USERNAME]
                     [--auth-password PASSWORD] [--recipient-auth MODE]
                     [--pickup-code CODE] [--recipient-public-key FILE]
                     [--recipient-email EMAILS] [--recipient-otp-api-base URL]
                     [--force-relay] [--e2ee] [--invite] [--qr [FILE]]
                     [--disable-clipboard] [--vfs] [--stdin-cache {on,off}]
                     [--background] [--foreground] [--alias ALIAS]
                     [--receipt [EMAIL[,EMAIL...]]]
                     [--receipt-confirm [MESSAGE]]
                     [--preferred-tunnel {default}]
                     [FILE_OR_FOLDER ...]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             Show version information and enabled addons
  --cli                 Run in CLI mode without GUI (optional)
  --log-level LEVEL_OR_FILE
                        Set logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR) or
                        path to logging config JSON file (default: WARNING)
  --proxy PROXY         Proxy server for all outbound connections. Formats:
                        [user:pass@]host:port (defaults to SOCKS5),
                        socks5[h]://[user:pass@]host:port,
                        http[s]://[user:pass@]host:port. SOCKS5 proxies work
                        for both tunnel and HTTP requests. HTTP proxies only
                        work for HTTP requests (not tunnel)
  --hook WEBHOOK_URL    Webhook URL for forwarding events to parent process or
                        external service. Format:
                        http://[user:pass@]host:port/path (e.g.,
                        http://app:token@127.0.0.1:12345/events). Auth
                        credentials are optional but recommended.
  --enable-reporting    Enable error reporting to FastFileLink server for
                        exception diagnostics

share:
  FILE_OR_FOLDER        File(s) or folder to share. Use '-' for stdin,
                        '@filelist.txt' to read paths from a file. Multiple
                        files can be specified: file1 file2 file3
  --name FILENAME, -n FILENAME
                        Specify custom download filename (default: original
                        filename for files, folder.zip for folders, stdin-
                        YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.bin for stdin)
  --exclude PATTERNS    Comma-separated patterns to exclude files/folders by
                        name (e.g. '*.log,.svn,__pycache__'). Prefix with
                        're:' for regex (e.g. 're:\.tmp$'). Applies at any
                        depth.
  --json JSON_FILE      Output link and settings to a JSON file
  --upload [{unavailable}]
                        Upload file to FastFileLink server to share it (Share
                        duration after upload). Default: 6 hours
  --resume              Resume a previously interrupted upload (requires
                        previous upload session to exist)
  --pause PERCENTAGE    Pause upload at specified percentage (1-99, requires
                        --upload)
  --yes                 Automatically answer yes to upload confirmation
                        prompts
  --legacy-link URL     Legacy P2P share link to recover after this server
                        upload completes
  --max-downloads MAXDOWNLOADS
                        Maximum number of downloads before the server
                        automatically shuts down (P2P mode only). 0 means
                        unlimited.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Timeout in seconds before the server automatically
                        shuts down (P2P mode only). 0 means no timeout.
  --port PORT           Port number for local server (1024-65535, default:
                        auto-detect available port)
  --auth-user USERNAME  Username for HTTP Basic Authentication (default:
                        'ffl')
  --auth-password PASSWORD
                        Password for HTTP Basic Authentication (enables auth
                        protection)
  --recipient-auth MODE
                        Enable recipient verification before download
  --pickup-code CODE    Custom 6-digit pickup code for recipient verification
  --recipient-public-key FILE
                        Recipient public key (.fflpub) file path for pubkey
                        verification
  --recipient-email EMAILS
                        Recipient email address(es) for email verification
                        (comma-separated)
  --recipient-otp-api-base URL
                        Base URL for OTP email API (e.g.
                        https://myserver.com/api). Required for --recipient-
                        auth email
  --force-relay         Force relayed P2P mode, disable direct WebRTC
                        connections (can be overridden by ?webrtc=on URL
                        parameter)
  --e2ee                Enable end-to-end encryption for file sharing (both
                        HTTP and WebRTC)
  --invite              Open invite page in browser with the sharing link
  --qr [FILE]           Display QR code in terminal (default) or save to FILE
                        (e.g., qr.png)
  --disable-clipboard   Disable automatically copying the share link to the
                        clipboard (default: enabled in CLI mode, disabled in
                        GUI mode)
  --vfs                 Start VFS server and provide vfs:// URI instead of
                        HTTPS link (P2P mode only, works with --port)
  --stdin-cache {on,off}
                        Enable or disable stdin caching ('off' means a second
                        read raises an error)
  --background          Submit share to background daemon (auto-starts daemon
                        if needed)
  --foreground          Run share in foreground even if a daemon is running
  --alias ALIAS         Use custom alias as UID for sharing link (e.g.,
                        --alias cool creates link with 'cool' as UID)
  --receipt [EMAIL[,EMAIL...]]
                        Send email receipt notification when download
                        completes. Omit value to use your account email
                        (requires non-free account). Accepts one or more
                        addresses separated by commas.
  --receipt-confirm [MESSAGE]
                        Show a confirmation dialog to the receiver after
                        download, asking them to acknowledge receipt.
                        Confirmation reply is sent to --receipt email(s) or
                        your account email (requires non-free account).
  --preferred-tunnel {default}
                        Set preferred tunnel for future runs. Available:
                        default
